provenance.why: Round 7.6: a second open ITPR3 deposit, from another laboratory, to test whether 8TKF's conductance shortfall is one deposit's substate. Found by an RCSB full-text search for 'inositol trisphosphate receptor' (2026-09-25): of the human ITPR3 entries only 8TKF (the 2023 8TK* series) and 7T3T (Schmitz 2022) are titled active/activated. Not in ip3r_genes' S11 panel, so kept out of the state panel (role open_control).

structures.title: IP3, ATP, and Ca2+ bound type 3 IP3 receptor in the active state
